acip: SKRA SHAD DANG SBRANG MA SOGS YIN PAR NGO BO LOG PA GANG ZHIG RNAM PAR BRTAGS PA NA, DE BSAL BAR 'DOD NAS SNOD DE LA YANG DANG YANG DU BSGRE BZLOG BYED PA'I TSEGS THOB PAR RIG STE,
english: When they think that they see something then, as different than it really is—when they see the hair or the fly or whatever it may be—then naturally they would want to get it out of the cup, and so it would be completely appropriate for them to go to the trouble of turning the cup upside down and knocking it against the table repeatedly, to get the unwanted thing out.
